notes:
Overview: Mid-market ecommerce SaaS (post-purchase support) evaluating Redwood. Team = product + engineering. Primary goal: replace a mix of scripted flows + 3rd-party chat bot for returns/shipping inquiries. Interested in starting on Hosted API for speed of integration, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput during peak seasons.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "Need p95 latency under 300ms for streaming agent flows during peak windows (Black Friday spikes)" - Head of Product
- "Tool calling essential: order lookup, shipment tracking, initiate return workflow from agent" - Staff Engineer
- "Pricing for peak refers to committed capacity vs burst pricing; want clear unit economics" - Finance lead

What they care about: streaming + tool-calling fidelity (low tail latency), canary rollouts, model routing by latency/cost, audit logs for customer support transcripts, NA data residency, SSO/SAML for Console access. Strong preference for predictable monthly cost during Nov-Dec windows.

Shorthand impressions from AE/SE:
- product demo 2026-02-11 looked good, streaming felt smooth on small demo traffic but need stress test
- SE follow-up to confirm tokenization effects on short agent responses (concise answers vs verbose)
- wants sample pricing for 100k monthly sessions with 2x peak multiplier

Status: evaluation/POC. Hosted API POC scheduled 2026-02-28. If SLA and cost profile OK, contract for Dedicated for Nov-Dec peak (reserve) likely.
timeline: 2026-02-01: Intro call (AE) - mapped use cases and SBUs
2026-02-15: Security questionnaire submitted; asked about audit_logging and data residency
2026-02-18: SE deep-dive on tool calling integration; recorded (ff_20260218_003)
2026-02-24: Pricing draft shared (drive deck), awaiting finance feedback
2026-02-28: POC kickoff (Hosted API) - 2 week traffic replay + latency soak planned
use_case_summary: Replacing scripted chat/support flows for post-purchase returns/shipping. Primary workload: chat/agent with tool calls (order lookup, RMA creation, shipment tracking). Need streaming responses with low p95 to maintain conversational feel. Expect seasonal peak (Nov-Dec) where throughput must scale predictably.
p95_latency_target: <= 300ms for streaming short-turn responses (goal); 95th percentile under load during peak windows
poc_details: 2-week Hosted API POC: integrate tool-calling hooks (order API), replay 1m historical sessions (sampled), run load test to simulate 2x peak traffic, measure p95 and streaming performance, validate audit logs and SSO access. Success criteria: p95 < 300ms on 95% of simulated peak windows, correct tool-call routing, and clear pricing estimate for Dedicated commitment.
integration_notes: Will use webhook-based tool calling + backend order service. Engineering: Node.js microservice to wrap order lookup. Wants SDK examples for streaming + tool calling and guidance on batching for token reduction.
commercial_notes: Initial ARR target $50k-$150k. Prefers committed Reserved Dedicated pricing for Nov-Dec. Request: cost model for Hosted->Dedicated migration and burst policies. Finance concerned about overage costs during flash sales.
security_ops: Must pass Security FAQ: SSO/SAML for Console, audit_logging retention 1 year, data residency in NA (log export for compliance). CISO team will run SOC2 checklist; provided security deck (linked_drive_docs).
internal_comments: AE: strong product fit, likely to convert if latency + pricing align. SE: main risk is peak tail latency under burst; recommend pre-provisioned Dedicated lanes or autoscaling SLA. Next: schedule performance workshop w/ infra team during POC.
